what: two exactly periodic orbits (theta = 0) on the satellite curves of Broucke's R family, found by following the satellite of the T* = 17.847 and 19.769 orbits (tools/family-follow.mjs) to its second zero of theta, refined to 30 digits with tools/refine-mp.py (u1 u2 lam t 30; the closure of the full period is measured on the rounded values written here). tools/satellite-candidates.mjs recomputes T*, L*, word, alignments, repeats, stability and the comparison with the atlas and with my lists from them; tools/satellite-check.py checks the closure and the multiplier with REBOUND. These orbits match nothing in the sources checked so far; they are not claimed to be new.
